title.narrative: EU4Culture: Promoting culture & creativity as an engine for economic growth and social development in EaP countries

description.narrative: The action aims to promote culture as an engine for growth and social development across the EaP region (overall objective). It promotes local cultural heritage, culture and creative industries as resources for socioeconomic development, inclusion and citizen participation (specific objective 1); favours intercultural dialogue for peaceful inter-community relations and knowledge sharing across the EaP partner countries (specific objective 2); and improves local governance in the culture sector through support for regulatory processes and participative policy dialogue (specific objective 3).
